summary: Created and verified `desk:apps:book`; typing, backspace, display, and saving “Mira” to `desk:guestbook` worked.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task start()
 give {guests: [], name: ''}
 when exists('desk:guestbook')
  set s.guests to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
 done
 give s
done
task key(s, k)
 when k is 'enter' and s.name is not ''
  add('desk:guestbook', s.name)
  add s.name to s.guests
  set s.name to ''
or when k is 'backspace' and count(s.name) > 0
 set s.name to slice(s.name, 1, count(s.name) - 1)
or when k is not 'enter'
 set s.name to edit_text(s.name, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
 show(1, 1, count(s.guests) & ' guests')
 set names to reverse(s.guests)
 set row to 3
 for each n in names
  when row < 23
   show(row, 1, n)
  done
  set row to row + 1
 done
 show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.name)
 help('Type name  Enter add  Backspace erase')
done
